prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Clean, modern 3D-minimal style, calm and trustworthy. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape behind the upper half.

1) Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#topilma".
2) Center: a chef's knife held by a small wooden magnetic block at an angle on a kitchen board, and a cylindrical metal roller with a sparkling diamond disc on one end rolling along the blade edge, with subtle motion arcs. Render it as a soft 3D clay illustration with matte surfaces in white and indigo (#4F46E5) with small touches of aqua (#22D3EE); soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, generous space around it.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold near-black (#11111B) headline, at most two lines: "Pichoqni «dumalatib» charxlang"
4) Under the headline, a smaller medium-grey line: "Bunday narsa borligini bilarmidingiz?"
5) Bottom, above a thin light divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo".

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
